{"script":"set -eu
mkdir -p temp_workspace
if [ -e /root/matrix.txt ]; then
  exists=yes
  size=$(stat -c%s /root/matrix.txt)
  perms=$(stat -c%A /root/matrix.txt)
else
  exists=no
  size=0
  perms=---
fi
printf "exists: %s\nsize: %s\npermissions: %s\n" "$exists" "$size" "$perms" > temp_workspace/matrix_metadata.txt
python3 - <<'PY' > temp_workspace/matrix_sanitized.txt
import sys,os
p='/root/matrix.txt'
if not os.path.exists(p):
    sys.exit(0)
with open(p,'rb') as f:
    data=f.read()
# normalize CRLF and CR to LF
data = data.replace(b'\r\n', b'\n').replace(b'\r', b'\n')
# remove trailing null bytes
while data.endswith(b'\x00'):
    data = data[:-1]
sys.stdout.buffer.write(data)
PY
head -n 10 temp_workspace/matrix_sanitized.txt > temp_workspace/matrix_preview.txt || true
cat > temp_workspace/compute_line_count <<'SH'
#!/bin/sh
# count lines in same directory's matrix_sanitized.txt and write only numeric result to /root/matrix_linecount.txt
wc -l < "$(dirname "$0")/matrix_sanitized.txt" > /root/matrix_linecount.txt
SH
chmod +x temp_workspace/compute_line_count
awk 'END{print NR}' /root/matrix.txt
"}
